products.title: Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette
products.body_html:
Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette is the confident man’s secret weapon for evenings. Designed for the man who knows how to own the night, this fragrance combines fresh aromatic notes with a smooth woody base that leaves a lasting impression.

It opens with crisp lavender and fresh birch, giving an energetic yet refined feel. The heart reveals soft violet, adding elegance and charm. Finally, deep woody notes and musk create a warm, masculine base that lingers till late.

Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette is the perfect scent for dinner dates, evening parties, or any time you want to look and feel powerful. One spray can instantly make you feel more attractive and self-assured.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Scent Spray Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Scent Spray Eau De Parfum was launched in 1999. This citrus aromatic fragrance for women is an absolute favourite of working and easy-going women. Francis Kurkdijian is the perfumer behind this absolute fragrance. The top notes of this scent include Lemon, Bergamot, Mint, Orange Peel and Rhubarb. While the heart tones and the dried tones include Jasmine, Musk, Oakmoss, Fennel, Carnation, White Amber, Musk, Oakmoss, Celery Seeds, Caraway, Cloves and Amber.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Rose des Vents Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Rose des Vents Eau de Parfum is a soft and fresh floral fragrance for women. It feels light, elegant, and very classy. The opening has juicy peach and black currant with green notes that give a clean and airy vibe. In the heart, different roses bloom with iris, making it powdery and smooth. The base of white musk, cedar, violet leaf and pepper adds a soft warm touch that stays close to the skin. It feels feminine, gentle, and very graceful.

products.title: Victoria's Secret Tease Creme Cloud Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Victoria's Secret Tease Crème Cloud Eau De Parfum is an exquisite, gentle, and sugary perfume that is specifically designed for the women who are fond of soft and warm scents. The fragrance has a beginning which is a silky and luscious combination of vanilla and meringue that gives a feeling of sugar and comfort. The fragrance then moves to the heart of soft sandalwood which imparts a milky touch while the base and musk are laced with amber to provide warmth and make the scent last longer. The perfume has a very clean and sweet quality and is extremely soothing, perfect for daily use.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shumoukh Al Ghutra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shumoukh Al Ghutra Eau de Parfum is a bold and classy leather based fragrance made for men who like strong yet clean scents. It initiates with the fresh and a bit green note of the apple and soft violet along with galbanum. When it becomes stable, the rich leather and dry cedar emerge, giving a masculine and confident air to the fragrance. The base is smooth and warm with vanilla and musk, thus making the scent everlasting and soothing yet still light.

products.title: Montale Roses Musk Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Roses Musk Eau De Parfum is one of the most simple yet beautiful rose perfumes from the house of Montale. It is a clean, bright and shiny kind of rose scent that mixes fresh rose petals, soft jasmine and a smooth white musk. The perfume smells elegant and a bit romantic, like fresh roses in a warm room. It is easy to wear every day and still feels classy.

products.title: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum is a women's perfume that is fresh, elegant, and at the same time, light and confident. It begins with a sweet and juicy blend of pear and bergamot and a hint of pink pepper for a little sparkle. Soft and floral heart is characterized by rose and jasmine, providing a gentle womanly feeling. The background is warm and smooth formed of white musk, vanilla, patchouli, and cedar that cling to the skin for hours. This perfume is modern, fresh, and ideal for women who appreciate clean, soft, and long-lasting fragrances.

products.title: Kayali Sparkling Lychee 39 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Sparkling Lychee 39 is a very sweet, fruity, and fresh perfume that is very bright from the first spray. The opening with juicy lychee, crisp red apple, and a tiny sparkle of lemon makes it very playful. In the middle, the soft violet, rose, and jasmine give a nice floral touch that is pleasant on skin. The dry down becomes warm and soothing with vanilla, sugar, musk, amber, sandalwood, and cedar. It is a cheerful, sugary, and girlish fragrance that is very suitable for daily use, informal occasions, and outdoor activities during the day.

products.title: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Cuir Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Cuir Intense is a rich and heavy leather perfume designed for both females and males. It is lush, creamy and somewhat smoky at the onset. Designed by Thierry Wasser in 2024, this perfume is a great leather feel that is pleasant and classy simultaneously. It has the confident feel to it and it is ideal to those who like strong, classy and long-lasting perfumes.

products.title: Giorgio Armano My Way Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: My Way Intense Giorgio Armani is a female oriental flower fragrance. It was released in 2021, and the nose behind this fragrance is Carlos Benaïm. It begins with bitter orange and orange blossom, which makes the beginning of the fragrance very bright and slightly sweet. The rich Indian tuberose, which feels creamy and strong, is in the heart. Madagascar vanilla and sandalwood are used in the base to give a warm and long-lasting touch.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau De Toilette is a beautiful scent in the Woody Floral Musk group, made to capture a feeling of peaceful, quiet calm and easy elegance. It starts with a citrusy smell of Mandarin. The middle of the scent moves into a smooth, dry softness, where the gentle touch of White Tea is nicely lifted by the soft, almost powdery feel of Iris and a light, green herb note. The final part rests on a comforting, skin-close foundation: three quiet Musks blend with warm, comforting Madras Wood and Ambrette Seed, creating a subtle, lasting fragrance that feels polished and lovely for wearing every day.

products.title: Bentley Silverlake Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Bentley For Men Silverlake Eau De Parfum is a fresh, modern, and masculine fragrance that captures the spirit of adventure. Inspired by clear mountain air and sparkling lakes, this scent combines crisp citrus with cool aromatic notes, creating an energising and refreshing experience.

The fragrance opens with a shot of zesty lemon and cool mint, instantly boosting your freshness. At its heart, violet leaves, lavender, and pink pepper add a clean, slightly spicy, and green touch, making it both elegant and sporty. The base of white musk and amberwood brings a smooth, warm, and long-lasting finish.

Bentley For Men Silverlake Eau De Parfum exudes a classy yet casual charm, perfect for the man who appreciates both sophistication and the great outdoors. One spray is like stepping into a crisp morning by a mountain lake, surrounded by fresh air and endless horizons.

products.title: BDK Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: BDK Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum is a fresh unisex perfume from the French perfume house BDK Parfums which was launched in 2020 this fragrance is made by perfumer Ralf Schewieger and captures the joy of the Mediterranean summers. It opens with Italian lemon, neroli, Italian mandarin and fig that give a juicy citrus and the middle notes bring green notes, watery touches, eucalyptus, orange blossom, strawberry, immortelle and jasmine which together feel airy and refreshing. The base is warm and grounding with Haitian vetiver, white musk, tonka bean and Indonesian patchouli leaf making it a smooth combination of fresh and woody accords.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Roses Vanilla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Rose Vanille Eau de Parfum is an alluring, sweet, and romantic fragrance created for the women who prefer floral and creamy scents. It starts with a fresh lemon note that is light and clean on the skin. A very rich rose note gradually comes into play and feels soft and classy. The base notes of vanilla, white musk, and cedarwood impart warmth, sweetness, and comfort that are close to the skin for a long time.

products.title: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur EDP is a bold, truly sensual choice. It works for everyone—men and women. The scent is famous for its warm, spicy, and deep musk feel. Maurice Roucel created Musc Ravageur in 2000. It opens with fresh energy. You first smell lavender, tangerine, and bergamot. That clean burst soon fades. The center quickly moves to a rich mix: cinnamon, cloves, and rose. This makes the perfume smooth. It gives a light, powdery touch. The base is where it locks down. Expect deep warmth here. Musk, vanilla, amber, and woods dominate. This strong finish makes Musc Ravageur unforgettable. It feels cozy; it feels mysterious. The scent is known for staying warm and strong on your skin all day.

products.title: Dumont Paris Nitro Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Paris Nitro Intense Eau de Parfum is a dark and strong men's perfume that has a sweet and woody touch. It begins with juicy pineapple and black currant, which smells opulent and faintly fruity. It becomes slowly warm with smoky aromas and spices which are very strong and manly. The dry down is creamy with vanilla, amber and woods that remain on the skin throughout long hours. This fragrance is strong, up-to-date and self-assured.

products.title: Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum is a perfume for both men and women. It feels warm, a bit mysterious, and very rich when you wear it. The perfume is inspired by saffron, which is a very special spice. It has a combination of sweet, spicy, and earthy smell that make it bold but still very elegant.

The perfume start with saffron, juniper berries and fresh citrus from Chinese grapefruit, giving a spicy and bright opening. In the middle, you get soft leather and gentle black violet that add some depth and floral touch. Later it settle down into raspberry, cashmeran and vetiver, which give a woody, musky and little sweet finish that stay for long.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Louis Vuitton Spell On You Eau de Parfum (LV x TM Limited Edition)
products.body_html: Spell On You Eau de Parfum by Louis Vuitton is a feminine fragrance that is a soft and floral scent. It is romantic, whitish and feminine. The smell begins with violet, Tuscan iris, and green that provide a fresh and even airy beginning. Then it gradually drifts into a gorgeous centre of iris, rose and jasmine, which is smooth and elegant. The foundation of white musk, peach, and acacia is soft and warm, sticks to the skin and can be considered elegant.

products.title: French Avenue Grecia White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Grecia White Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy and elegant unisex perfume made for people who like calm but noticeable scents. It opens with a smooth milky note mixed with ambrette, giving a clean and comforting feel. The heart has white florals like tuberose and jasmine with a light touch of incense that adds depth but is not smoke heavy. The base is warm and sweet with vanilla, musk, tonka bean and cacao, which stays gentle on skin for a long time.

products.title: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and bright unisex fragrance from the luxury house of Tom Ford. Inspired by the Italian Riviera, this perfume feels like a cool sea breeze mixed with fresh citrus fruits and white flowers. It opens with sharp and juicy citrus notes blended with soft herbs, then moves into smooth neroli and orange flower and finally settles into a light musky and amber base.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Herod Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums De Marly Herod is a warm, rich, and sophisticated fragrance for men that has a deep and silky character. The first impression is a combination of spicy cinnamon and pepperwood that comes off as daring and a bit sweet. Gradually, the whole thing becomes smoky with tobacco and incense, which is very powerful and masculine. The final stage is a blend of vanilla, woods, and musk that is very pleasant and lasts for a long time. This perfume is a statement of luxury and self-assurance and it's for men who are fond of strong and warm fragrances.

products.title: Neesh Glazed Water Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Glazed Water Extrait De Parfum is a fresh, clean and modern aquatic scent made for men who like a cool and classy smell. It starts with bright marine and citrus notes that are like a gentle sea breeze on the skin, turning spicy and soft gradually and finally, warm woody notes dominate the dry down. Due to the extrait concentration, the perfume feels light, refreshing and yet strong.

products.title: Montblanc Individuel Eau De Toilette For Men
products.body_html: Montblanc Individuel Eau De Toilette is a classy and clean men’s perfume with a soft, sweet and woody feel. The first impression of the fragrance is a striking combination of herbs and spices with a tiny bit of fruit, but the transition to warmth and smoothness is rather slow. Along the way, the aroma becomes very soft and sweet.

products.title: Marc Antoine Barrois Tilia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Marc Antoine Barrois Tilia Eau de Parfum is a soft, airy and elegant unisex fragrance. It feels bright, floral and very comforting on the skin. The scent opens with fresh lime blossom mixed with jasmine sambac and broom, giving it a light, sunny feel. The heart turns creamy and smooth with heliotrope, orange blossom and vetiver. The base is clean, woody and slightly musky with Ambrofix™ and Georgywood, making the scent long lasting and modern.

products.title: Jimmy Choo Man Ice Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jimmy Choo Man Ice Eau De Toilette is a modern and delightful men’s perfume that presents a very clean, fresh, and slightly sweet scent. At one end, the fragrance has a very strong, sharp, icy freshness, owing to citrus notes like citron, bergamot, and mandarin. In the centre of the fragrance development, the smell turns to be somewhat woody and fruity with the apple, cedar, and vetiver parts providing a very gentle mix. Musk, ambroxan, and moss, which is the foundation, keep it soft, modern, and very wearable. It is an uncomplicated yet cultured fragrance for regular applications.

products.title: Hermes Voyage d'Hermes Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Hermes Voyage d’Hermes Eau de Toilette is a fresh, clean and soft woody fragrance for both men and women. It opens bright with cardamom, lemon and light spices that feel lively and uplifting, then moves into smooth tea notes with green and floral touches that add a calm feeling. The dry down is warm and gentle with woods, musk and cedar, giving a soft, cosy finish. It feels elegant, simple, and easy to wear for daily life, perfect for people who like a clean, refreshing scent that still feels classy.

products.title: Franck Olivier Night Touch Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Night Touch Eau De Toilette is really smooth, and nice. It smells fresh, warm, and kinda mysterious all at the same time. When you first spray Night Touch, you get a bright smell of bergamot, pineapple, and cardamom - that’s a clean and energetic start. After a bit, you smell flowery and spicy stuff like geranium, nutmeg, and violet that makes Night Touch nice and balanced. The last smell you get is a rich, manly one with patchouli, musk, and amber that stays softly on your skin for a long time.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense For Woman Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Light Blue Eau Intense for women by Dolce & Gabbana boasts a refreshing Mediterranean summer character. It contains a citrus and green apple head note that transitions to soft, feminine floral notes resting on a warm, musky amberwood base. The perfume opens with lemon and Granny Smith apple, along with the heart note of jasmine and marigold, and rests on a gorgeous base of amberwood and musk. This is a bold and strong Eau De Parfum that lasts longer than earlier releases. Additionally, it offers versatility to wear every day, or as a complex fragrance, suitable for occasions that call for it.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a deep, elegant, and modern fragrance for men who like to stand out without trying too hard. Intenso Pour Homme is all about pure instinct, a strong, masculine scent that balances rich, woody notes with fresh green touches.

This fragrance opens with fresh basil and watery notes that feel clean and sharp. In the heart, a unique blend of lavender, tobacco, and hay gives Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme a warm and slightly sweet feel. The base is where it gets deep and classy, with sandalwood, amber, labdanum, and musk giving a strong, long-lasting finish.

Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is perfect for the modern Indian man who wants to feel confident, sophisticated, and ready to leave a strong impression wherever he goes.

products.title: Carolina Herrera 212 Men NYC Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera 212 Men NYC Eau de Toilette is a new, clean, modern perfume that brings the smooth, refined touch of its perfume. The perfume opens with the notes of green, grapefruit and light spices that give the impression of freshness and vigour. The perfume evolves into a calm, sophisticated condition with the soft floral and spicy tones, which are brought out in the process of settling. The base has woody and musky components, and these components stay on the skin longer.

products.title: Neesh Cologne Sophistique Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Cologne Sophistique Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, clean and classy men’s perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent is made for men who like a neat, modern and confident smell. It opens with bright citrus notes that feel fresh and energizing, then slowly moves into soft florals and green tones. Smooth, warm and slightly creamy with woods, musk and vanilla is the base, which gives a polished touch but at the same time is suitable for everyday wear.

products.title: French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume made for people who love deep oriental scents. It opens fresh but slowly turns dark, warm and very luxurious. The fragrance starts with bright citrus notes, then moves into soft florals and finally settles into a heavy oud and musky base. French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum feels classy, slightly wild and very strong in character.

products.title: Scent Story 24 Gold Oud Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Scent Story 24 Gold Oud Eau De Toilette is a bold, warm and rich unisex perfume made for people who love strong woody scents. The scent opens with the spicy notes of the hot and lively feel, then gradually intermingles with a warm and deep woodiness and increasingly comes on to a sweet, smoky oud base. The fragrance is still smooth on the skin and feels luxurious and powerful. Perfect if you are a fan of oud combined with spices and soft sweetness. The musk feels modern but has a slight Arabic like touch, making it suitable for both men and women.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum is a tender, sweet and touch spicy female perfume that is rich and contemporary in its touch and feel. The introduction is sweet and crisp with plump rambutan and grapefruit with a touch of cardamom. Bulgarian rose and peony make their appearance in the heart with a touch of romantic floral flavour sprinkled with blackcurrant sweetness. Caramel and incense base is creamy, warm and a bit smoky and thus long-lasting and elegant. This perfume is feminine, self-confident, and suitable for those women who admire sweet flowers with a warm touch.

products.title: Montblanc Legend Night Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montblanc Legend Night Eau de Parfum is a dark, smooth and classy men’s fragrance from the house of Montblanc. It opens fresh and spicy with mint, cardamom and bergamot, which feels clean but also a little warm. Slowly it moves into soft fruity and woody notes like apple, lavender and cedar that feel calm and confident. The base is deep and sensual with vanilla, musk, patchouli and vetiver, giving the scent a night time, elegant feel.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun MMMM.... Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun MMMM.... Eau de Parfum is a women's / men's perfume. MMMM.... was released in 2016. The major notes include Raspberry, Geranium and Neroli; Tuberose, Iris, Jasmine Sambac and Orange Blossom. Vanilla, Caramel, Sandalwood, Heliotrope, White Musk and Patchouli are the base notes. It starts with a luscious raspberry which is delightful and light-hearted and gradually changes to the mild floral core of white. Drying out, there is a blend of vanilla and caramel with sandalwood and musk, making it warm, smooth and cosy and hard to forget, lasting the hours.

products.title: Gucci Guilty Man Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Parfum is a warm, woody, and fresh masculine perfume that feels bold but also soft in the drydown. It opens with clean and bright top notes of juniper, lavender, and lemon. The heart brings a smooth combination of orange blossom, nutmeg, and Spanish labdanum that adds warmth and depth. The base settles into dry wood, patchouli, and musk, giving a strong and charming finish. The blend feels modern, classy, and perfect for men who like deep and comforting scents.

products.title: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau de Parfum is a bright and tropical unisex perfume that captures the fresh breeze of the Caribbean islands. The creators, Olivier Creed and Erwin Creed, introduced this perfume in 2007. With lime, coconut, and rum being the primary notes of this scent, it takes you to a sunny beach in an instant. The smoothness and refreshing of the holiday mood that this fragrance brings can be enjoyed by anyone who loves to smell beachy and feel-good scents.

products.title: Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum (2024)
products.body_html:
Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum is a bold, classy, and refreshing fragrance made for royalty and for those who live like one. Inspired by the Duke of Windsor and the upscale Mayfair district in London, this scent feels luxurious, clean, and crisp. It perfectly blends aromatic, floral, and green notes with a soft woody base to create a refined signature scent.

Creed Royal Mayfair smells like confidence in a bottle. It starts fresh and sharp, thanks to British gin and lime, and then flows into sweet rose and smooth eucalyptus, finishing with soft cedarwood. Whether you’re heading to a formal dinner, an office meeting, or a classy brunch, Royal Mayfair will leave a polished and sophisticated impression.

products.title: Lattafa Ekhtiari Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ekhtiari Eau de Parfum is an Aromatic Fruity perfume of both women and men. Ekhtiari was launched in 2019. The top notes are Mandarin Orange and Fruits; the middle ones are Jasmine and Gardenia and the bottom ones are Musk, Vanilla and Tonka Bean.It is neither too bulky nor too light. It is easy to wear both by men and women. Weary well on a daily basis, in the office, on casual outings or even in small gatherings. It reeks of contemporary, no frills, and it is very nice.

products.title: Xerjoff Alexandria II Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Xerjoff Alexandria II Eau de Parfum is a lavish and harmonious perfumery where the warm, woodsy, and subtly sugary notes dominate. The perfume opens with gentle lavender, apple, and cinnamon that create a neat and elegant beginning. Gradually, the fragrance proceeds to a floral and woody heart consisting of rose and cedar. During the dry down phase, the oud, sandalwood, vanilla, and amber feel deep, creamy, and very rich. The fragrance is a bait, calming and giving off a powerful aura. It is ideally suited for those who are fond of wearing strong niche scents.

products.title: Montblanc Individuel Tonic Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Montblanc Individuel Tonic Eau de Toilette is a fresh yet warm scent that was introduced in 2018, made for everyday wear. It opens with a clean mix of mint, juniper berries, bergamot and pineapple that feels cool and energetic. The middle has soft floral notes like geranium, violet and orange blossom, which add smoothness. The base settles into woody, sweet tones of sandalwood, musk, vanilla and a hint of dark chocolate, giving a calm, modern finish.

products.title: Guerlain Heritage Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Heritage Eau de Parfum is an iconic fragrance for men with a woody-spicy character. It starts with a fresh and powdery note, then leads to a warm, spicy heart and finally ends on a dry woody note. It has the sophistication of the past, a hint of vintage, and is perfect for occasions when a self-assured, classic scent is desired.

products.title: French Avenue Sweet Paradise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Sweet Paradise Eau de Parfum is a light and cheerful perfume targeted at women who will appreciate sweet and fresh perfumes. It has a light fruity sensation in the beginning, with the mixture of mandarin and clear musk that is very smooth. Soft flowers and peach make the heart feel creamy and soft. The foundation is cosy and sweet with tonka and heliotrope, so the smell is very soothing and permanent. Worn all the time and on special occasions.

products.title: Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean, and sophisticated fragrance that captures the green spirit of nature with a luxurious twist. Unlike traditional vetiver scents that use only the root, Creed uses the entire vetiver plant, leaves, roots, and heartwood, resulting in a smooth, earthy, and uplifting scent.

This unisex fragrance feels elegant yet sporty, perfect for people who love refreshing yet long-lasting perfumes. It opens with a crisp green burst and gradually melts into warm, woody softness. Creed Original Vetiver is ideal for anyone who wants to smell fresh, refined, and put-together throughout the day.

products.title: Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum by Creed is a warm and spicy woody perfume that is suitable for men and women. It is luxurious within the initial spray. Scent is based upon the sandalwood and light spices, which are creamy and feel royal and confident. It is ideal for individuals who enjoy powerful but cosy perfumes that remain with them throughout the day.

products.title: Amouage Reasons Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Reasons Eau de Parfum is a deep, modern, and soulful fragrance that invites you on a journey of discovery. It’s more than just a scent; it’s an experience. Crafted for the confident individual, this perfume mix of warm spices, rich woods, and a hint of nutty sweetness to create a truly unforgettable aroma.

Reasons smell like finding comfort in sophistication. It wraps you in a warm, elegant embrace that is both powerful and peaceful. This fragrance is perfect for those who want a signature scent that tells a story of wisdom, confidence, and quiet strength. With Amouage Reasons, you don’t just enter a room, you bring a unique and captivating presence with you.

products.title: Amouage Jubilation XXV Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Jubilation XXV Man is not just a perfume; it's a statement of royalty, celebration, and timeless elegance.Crafted for the man who is a king in his own right, this fragrance is a true masterpiece of modern perfumery. Imagine stepping into a grand palace, filled with the rich aroma of sweet incense, exotic spices, and precious woods. That is the experience of Jubilation XXV.

This scent is incredibly rich, complex, and majestic. It captures a feeling of pure happiness and achievement, making it the perfect scent for life's biggest moments. A spray of Amouage Jubilation XXV Man feels like wearing a crown; it’s confident, luxurious, and unforgettable.

products.title: Acqua di Parma Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Acqua di Parma Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and elegant oriental woody fragrance made for both men and women. It was launched in 2019 by the luxury brand Acqua di Parma, known for classy Italian scents. It opens with fresh orange and Calabrian bergamot, giving a clean citrus start. Then, amyris and coriander bring a warm woody spice. In the base, leather, sandalwood, cedar, musk and patchouli create a deep, smooth and long lasting finish.

products.title: Tom Ford Oud Voyager Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Oud Voyager Eau de Parfum is a rich and spicy woody fragrance for women and men. It opens with fresh geranium, pink pepper, and a touch of citrus that feels bright and slightly sharp. After some time, the heart becomes warm with red peony, cardamom, and saffron, giving a soft spicy feel. In the base, oud, vetiver, patchouli, and musk create a deep, smoky, and long-lasting trail. It feels bold, elegant, and perfect for someone who likes strong woody scents.

products.title: Sospiro Vibrato Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Sospiro Vibrato Eau de Parfum is a fresh and luxurious perfume for men and women. The initial spray is light and energetic, containing grapefruit and bergamot as a sharp citrus touch. Jasmine and magnolia bring soft smoothness to the flower, therefore, it is balanced and clean. Light spice and warmth are introduced as it settles with ginger and herbal notes. The musk, cedar, amber, orris root, and patchouli base provide a creamy woody finish, which lasts many hours. It is very memorable, luxurious and very contemporary and lightweight.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Oajan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Oajan Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet, spicy perfume for both men and women, launched in 2013. It opens warm and sweet with cinnamon, honey and soft fruity osmanthus notes. The middle brings resin, amber and a soft herbal touch that feels deep and cozy. The base is creamy and smooth with vanilla, tonka bean, musk and patchouli.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Hedonist Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilo Hedonist Eau de Parfum is a smooth, woody-smelling fragrance that is targeted at both men and women. At the same time, it is clean, fresh, and warm. The smell starts fresh and a bit spicy, and gradually turns woody and tender. It is not overpowering, but it is good and opulent to touch. This perfume is ideal for individuals who enjoy sophisticated, contemporary and durable scents that are relaxing and assured.

products.title: Zimaya Mazaaj Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Zimaya Mazaaj Eau de Parfum is a rich and modern fragrance that feels warm, slightly spicy and smooth. The scent opens with a fresh touch of citrus and spices which gives a bright start. After some time aromatic notes begin to appear, adding a soft and elegant feel. As it settles down, woody and amber notes create a warm base that stays on the skin for many hours and gives a classy masculine vibe.

products.title: Xerjoff Torino 21 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Xerjoff Torino 21 is a vibrant and nature-friendly perfume that exudes a clean, sharp, and energizing vibe. It starts with lemon and mint, which are both zesty and refreshing, to awaken the senses and to make them feel cool and full of energy. The next step comprises smooth and aromatic lavender, jasmine, and rosemary which are blended together and they share their calmness and fragrance with each other. The musk and vervain combination at the bottom gives a gentle and lasting, therefore, very nice to stay on the skin for hours freshness. Modern, cheerful, and unisex, this scent is nothing but perfect for the ones who adore the crisp, green, and bold perfumes.

products.title: Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Eau de Parfum is a fresh, bright and relaxing unisex fragrance inspired by the Italian coast. The fragrance feels very natural, sunny and clean on the skin. The very beginning of the fragrance is dominated by succulent citruses and green herbs, that is, crispness and cheerfulness. The middle notes present a mild floral and spicy aspect, whereas the base remains muted, warm and musky.

products.title: Rasasi Nafaeis Al Shaghaf Pour Femme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Nafaeis Al Shaghaf Pour Femme Eau De Parfum from Rasasi is a fragrance for women who love warm and creamy scents. The perfume is soft, sweet and elegant. The fragrance starts with a warm mix of almond, lemon and coffee that is creamy and slightly sweet. The middle turns floral with jasmine, tuberose, iris and lily, giving it a rich and feminine touch. The dry down reveals a warm and soft base consisting of vanilla, musk, sandalwood and amber, which is quite close to the skin and very satisfying. This perfume is simple, classy and easy to wear for daily use as well as special moments.

products.title: Prada Candy Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Candy Eau De Parfum is a lovely, warm, and, in fact, very irresistible women’s fragrance. It starts with a deep caramel note that is very smooth and at the same time very tasty, even from the first spray. Gradually, hints of powdery notes and soft musk come very subtly and the fragrance feels more and more like a warm cocoon around women. The rich and deep base of vanilla and benzoin provides the lingering warmth and depth that lasts for hours and hours. This perfume has an aura of playfulness, elegance, and is definitely for women who adore sweet scents.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Valaya Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Valaya Eau de Parfum is a soft, clean and elegant scent. Released in 2023, this perfume feels light yet classy with a fresh, fruity, floral style. It opens with airy aldehydes, juicy white peach, bergamot and mandarin orange. The heart brings soft florals like orange blossom, lily-of-the-valley and modern notes like Petalia and Nympheal blended with light vetiver and mahonia. The base dries down into smooth musk, creamy vanilla, ambroxan and woody akigalawood, giving it a clean and comforting finish.

products.title: Ormonde Jayne Nawab Of Oudh Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ormonde Jayne Nawab Of Oudh Eau de Parfum is a unisex oriental fragrance from Ormonde Jayne, created by Geza Schoen. Launched in 2012, it combines spicy, floral, and woody notes into a smooth, luxurious scent. Orange, bergamot, cardamom, aldehydes and green notes introduce the fragrance with fresh and zesty top notes. The middle notes of the scent are composed of the floral and warm notes of rose, pimento, cinnamon, orchid, magnolia, bay leaf and hedione. Finally, the base notes provide a rich and deep finish of agarwood (oud), ambergris, vetiver, musk and labdanum.

products.title: Nishane Ani X Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nishane Ani X Extrait de Parfum is a rich and modern unisex scent. Launched in 2023, it is a deeper and more intense take on the famous Ani DNA with a fresh fruity opening and creamy sweet woody base. The fragrance opens with bright lemon, bergamot, ginger, melon, cardamom, water notes and pink pepper that feel fresh and lively. The heart brings green apple, black currant, lavender, patchouli, sage and rose, which add a soft, fruity and aromatic touch. The base has smooth vanilla, sandalwood, cashmere wood, cedar, ambergris and white musk that blend and create a warm, sweet trail that stays long and feels elegant.

products.title: Neesh Luxe Aoud Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Luxe Aoud Extrait De Parfum from the house of Neesh Perfumes is a rich and deep unisex perfume made for people who love strong oud scents. The opening reveals a spiced, dark and floral fragrance that is warm and bold at the same time. As the perfume goes along, smoky incense with delicate flowers appears gradually. The base is composed of heavy oud, thick wood and musk that remains in your presence long and seriously.

products.title: Lattafa Mashmoom Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Attar Mashmoom by Lattafa Perfumes is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Attar Mashmoom was launched in 2025. Top notes are Rose and Bergamot; middle notes are Caramel and Peony; base notes are Musk and Vanilla.

products.title: Killian Love don't be Shy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Killian Love Don’t Be Shy Eau de Parfum is a sweet, playful, and addictive fragrance that feels like a warm hug of soft candy and flowers. This famous perfume is loved by many for its delicious marshmallow and caramel notes that remind you of first love and sweet memories.

Killian Love Don’t Be Shy is perfect for women who want to smell sweet, romantic, and noticeable. One spray is enough to make you feel like you are wearing luxury and joy on your skin. It is a perfume that gets compliments and makes people ask, “What are you wearing?”

products.title: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and timeless fragrance that captures the spirit of coastal luxury and warm sunshine. Created by the House of Creed in 1995, this iconic scent is loved by both men and women for its clean, citrusy freshness with a smooth musky finish.

Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de fragrance opens with a burst of juicy fruits and sea breeze, making you feel like you’re walking along a royal Mediterranean coast. As it develops, warm woods and musk add depth and sophistication, making it a perfect choice for those who want a scent that’s both refreshing and classy.

Creed Millésime Impérial is a fragrance that fits every season and every occasion. Whether it’s a sunny day, a romantic evening, or a formal event, this perfume makes you feel confident, clean, and irresistible.

products.title: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fruity and soft perfume that is designed to suit women who place a premium on modern and great style perfumes. The perfume opens with light-hearted and sweet scents of strawberry and raspberry, and cherry berry. The violet and jasmine floral notes come out to produce a feminine touch. Vanilla and musk mixed with the woody in the base notes of the fragrance are warm and smooth on the skin all day long.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Lady Vengeance Extreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Girl Lady Vengeance Extreme Eau de Perrier is a strong, rich and intense chypre perfume targeting women who like aggressive scents. It is black, sexy and bold after the initial spray. The heavy patchouli is mixed with Bulgarian rose and smooth vanilla to produce a warm and slightly sweet scent. This perfume is not tender or modest; it is bold, assertive and crafted to be conspicuous.

products.title: Franck Olivier Pure Addiction Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Franck Olivier Pure Addiction Eau De Parfum is a really smooth, warm, and mysterious smell. It feels modern but also comforting, you know? It starts with a soft, fresh burst of orange, that gives Pure Addiction a clean and welcoming start. After a bit, you smell saffron, marigold, and jasmine. This adds a spicy, flowery touch that feels elegant and kind of addictive at the same time. The base smells are white amber, praline, moss, and white cedar. This gives Pure Addiction its rich depth. The creamy sweet of praline mixes perfectly with the wood and musk. 

This makes the scent cozy, sexy, and great for both guys and girls. Pure Addiction has that classy balance of sweet and warm that never smells too strong. Pure Addiction is a smell that slowly gets better on you. It's fresh first, then deep and smooth later. Franck Olivier Pure Addiction is perfect for people who like a sweet perfume but want a bit of edge and warmth too.

products.title: Bath & Body Works In the Stars Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: In The Stars by Bath & Body Works is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. In The Stars was launched in 2017.

products.title: Orto Parisi Megamare Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Orto Parisi Megamare Extrait De Parfum is an invigorating and oceanic fragrance. Its top notes consist of a sparkling bergamot and lemon that are bright, clean, and lively, and then the heart of the scent takes you to the beach with seaweed, calone, and hedione that have a watery, marine quality. Musk, ambroxan, and cedar form the base of the perfume that is gentle, velvety, and durable. This fragrance gives the impression of being refreshing, contemporary, and suitable for lovers of water and fresh air scents from nature.

products.title: Orto Parisi Bergamask Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Orto Parisi Bergamask Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that mixes fresh citrus with soft florals and warm woods. The fragrance was introduced in 2014 and its initial notes are bright and sharp with bergamot and lemon, then it goes into the floral note of lavender, orange blossom and lily of the valley and finally to a warm musk, cedar and tonka.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez Vetiver Musc Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Narciso Rodriguez Vetiver Musc Eau de Toilette is a fresh, clean and earthy men’s perfume. The perfume was launched in 2024, and it gives off a natural and calming scent, however, it is still very masculine. First, it opens with green and spicy notes, then it moves to a soft musky heart and finally, it sinks into a woody base that feels smooth and lasts for a long time.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdijan Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum is a warm, smooth and elegant unisex fragrance made for people who love soft sweetness with depth. Launched in 2019, this perfume feels creamy, cozy and classy at the same time. It opens with fresh, spicy notes of juniper berries and nutmeg, which give a clean, airy start. The middle has coriander, adding a soft spicy warmth. The base is where the magic happens, with rich vanilla, soft musk, caramel sweetness and amberwood, creating a long lasting, comforting scent that stays close to the skin.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Legere Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Légère Eau de Parfum is a modern, bold perfume for women. Launched in 2018, it is a lighter and fresher version of the original Good Girl, balancing sweet, floral, and warm notes perfectly. The fragrance opens with bright and fresh top notes of ylang-ylang, mandarin orange, bergamot, and lemon; the heart is full of floral beauty with tuberose, jasmine, orange blossom, and Bulgarian rose. The base adds depth with dulche de leche, praline, tonka bean, cinnamon, cashmerwood, sandalwood, musk, amber, patchouli, and cedar, leaving a warm, long-lasting trail.

products.title: Armaf Island Bliss Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Island Bliss Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is soft, sweet, and cheerful which is made for women loving the aroma of fresh tropical fruits. The fragrance opens with wild berries and green notes which are light and playful. Eventually, it becomes creamy with the addition of coconut, orange blossom, and water lily, thus a beach-like setting is created. The dry down has vanilla, tonka bean, and musk that are close to the skin and are warm, smooth, and comforting. This perfume has a relaxing, feminine and casual vibe which is perfect for everyday use.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Citrus Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Citrus Oud Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is refreshing and fragrant but still in the wood category, and it is designed for both female and male. It starts with a bright mix of mandarin and cardamom which is blended in a clean and spicy way. While it is getting prepared to settle down, soft jasmine, and woody notes take over, which creates a smooth and classy atmosphere. The base of oud, patchouli, musk, and cedarwood adds richness and longevity. This fragrance feels luxurious, contemporary, and comfortable to wear.

products.title: Ajmal Amir One Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Amir One Eau de Parfum is a rich and elegant unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy a balanced mix of fresh, floral and deep woody notes. The top notes are sparkling, citrusy scented bergamot and lemon, along with soothing lavender and clary sage. As it settles, scent brings the mixture of sandalwood, rose, jasmine and soft white flowers that are smooth and flowery. The base is very warm and lasts a long time with the presence of oud, amber and musk, which gives it a classy and slightly royal sensation.

products.title: Lalique  White Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Lalique White Eau De Toilette is a fresh Citrus aromatic men's fragrance. It is clean, sharp and classy as soon as it sprays on. The introduction is sunny and lemon leaf and bergamot create a cool and somewhat tangy impression. It is smooth and settles down, unearthing soft spices such as white pepper and cardamom. The cedar and the musk provide a smooth woody foundation in the dry down, which remains on the skin.

products.title: Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum is an intense, warm, and truly unforgettable fragrance for men. Inspired by adventure and freedom, this perfume combines the deep warmth of rum with exotic dried fruits, rich spices, and smooth woods. It feels bold yet smooth, giving you a confident vibe that lasts all day.

Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum is made for men who like to stand out. A splash of this perfume feels like stepping into a world of luxury, strong, stylish, and full of character. Perfect for evening parties, romantic nights, or when you want to feel your absolute best.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Moscow Mule Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Moscow Mule Eau de Parfum is a citrus aromatic perfume for both women and men. Moscow Mule was launched in 2017. The nose of Romano Ricci backs this perfume. It starts on new notes of Bergamot, Lime, and Lemon. Ginger, Hedione, and Apple are added to the heart, giving the heart a spicy and slightly fruity touch. It is drying down to White Musk, Woody Notes, Ambrette, and Amberwood and has a clean and smooth finish to it.

products.title: Ajmal Amir Two Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Amir Two Eau de Parfum from Ajmal fragrances is a rich and modern unisex perfume made for people who like deep and bold scents. The top notes are a spicy and flowery blend, which are warm and slightly fresh. After some time, the fragrance becomes woody and smooth with a soft amber touch. The base notes are dark, smoky and musky, resembling an intense Middle Eastern essence that is very close to skin and very elegant.

products.title: Xerjoff Tony Iommi Deified Parfum
products.body_html: Deified Tony Iommi Parfum by Xerjoff is a perfume that is utilised by women and men. In 2024, it released Deified Tony Iommi Parfum. The perfume starts with a luxurious and spicy blend of saffron, apple and cinnamon that is warm and a bit sweet. Leather and rose are added in heart to give a deep and smooth touch to the scent. The bottom of papyrus, patchouli, musk and moss provides a woody, ground and deep-seated end that is daring and extravagant.

products.title: Nusuk Ana Al Awwal Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Ana Al Awwal Silver Eau de Parfum is a bold and fresh leather scent made for men who like a clean yet strong smell. It opens with bright, fruity and fresh marine notes mixed with soft lavender and spicy pepper. The middle comes with soft florals and woody cedar that feel smooth and balanced. The base is warm and masculine with leather, musk and patchouli, giving a classy and lasting trail.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Fleur Narcotique Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Fleur Narcotique Extrait de Parfum begins with a sunny and juicy combination of litchi and bergamot that is smooth and bright. After a certain period, there are soft floral tones of peony, freesia, orange blossom, and jasmine emerging and rendering the smell graceful and creamy. The foundation of musk, sandalwood and moss provides a fresh and clean woody feel that lasts many hours on the skin. This perfume is fresh, floral, and a bit sensual, which is ideal for those who like soft yet powerful luxury fragrances.

products.title: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Forever Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Forever Eau De Parfum is described as joy in a bottle. It’s bright, juicy, and full of life fragrance makes it stand out. The fragrance has a cheerful splash of raspberry and zesty lemon peel, launching right into a sweet, vibrant start - that is sure to lift your spirits immediately. As the scent dried down, the heart tones present a blend of sweet almond, black currant, rose, and orange blossom. This feminine fragrance is perfect for any elegant, playful, pleasant look. The base notes are rooted in warm and cozy vibes with the scent of vanilla, patchouli, and musk. This fragrance feels like a warm hug. If you are a woman looking forward to a fresh and sweet scent, then this is for you.

products.title: Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum by Versace is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum was launched in 2014. The fragrance opens with bright and fresh notes of Sicilian lemon, pomegranate and Calabrian bergamot, which feel juicy and energetic. The heart brings a soft floral mix of lemon blossom, jasmine sambac, jasmine and peony. In the base, sandalwood, musk, ambroxan and woody notes create a warm, smooth and long-lasting finish that feels elegant and feminine.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Mousuf Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ard Al Zaafaran Mousuf Eau de Parfum is a sweet and warm, but a little bit dark, fragrance created for women who are fond of heavy scents, The fragrance opens up with a delicious and soft mixture of grapes and chocolate that is very inviting. It calms down and the warmth and depth of the oud and musk are felt. In the end, toffee, tobacco, and delicate florals linger on the skin for hours. This perfume gives the impression of being sweet, soft, and very addictive.

products.title: Rasasi Entebaa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Entebaa Eau de Parfum is a bold and warm oriental fragrance made for men who like strong and sweet scents. It opens with a fruity and spicy mix that feels rich and energetic. Then, the wood and earth notes take over, creating an atmosphere of depth and masculinity. The final notes are a mixture of creaminess, sweetness and slight hints of gourmand, making Rasasi Entebaa a perfume that is very much alive and noticeable for a long period.

products.title: Orto Parisi Viride Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Orto Parisi Viride Extrait de Parfum is a bold green and woody unisex perfume from the artistic house of Orto Parisi. Launched in 2014, it is known for its raw, natural smell, which feels earthy, fresh and slightly smoky at the same time. The scent opens with herbal green notes of wormwood, artemisia and lavender; moves into soft floral jasmine in the middle; and settles into a deep forest like base of fir, juniper, cedar, tobacco and musk.

products.title: Franck Boclet Erotic Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Erotic Eau De Parfum for Men & Women is a strong perfume. It is an incredible blend of warm spice and smooth wood notes. The scent kicks off with a fresh burst of rosemary, lemon, bergamot, and basil. This gives it a clean, slightly spicy opening. The middle layer has a lot going on: benzoin, heliotrope, cardamom, patchouli, tuberose, lavender, and oakmoss. This adds a lot of depth, plus creamy sweetness and rich herbs. The bottom notes are heavy. You get vanilla, amber, incense, sandalwood, and leather. Musk and cedar soften the whole thing up. This makes the entire scent finish deep and totally luxurious.

products.title: Amouage Lustre Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Lustre Eau de Parfum is a radiant and sophisticated unisex fragrance that feels like liquid sunshine on the skin. A modern masterpiece from the House of Amouage, this scent is designed to evoke a sense of pure elegance and a radiant aura. It beautifully balances warm spices, soft florals, and creamy woods to create a fragrance that is both comforting and captivating.

Amouage Lustre smells incredibly luxurious yet is easy to wear. It has a rich depth and a warm glow that makes you feel special and confident. It’s the perfect choice for those who love modern, elegant fragrances that leave a lasting, memorable impression. One spray of Amouage Lustre will wrap you in a golden embrace, making you feel polished and effortlessly chic.

products.title: Al Haramain Musk Attar Roll On
products.body_html: Musk by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Ego Stratis Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Ego Stratis Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume. Ego Stratis was launched in 2022. It begins with new notes of Bergamot, Lemon and Mandarin Orange. Sea Notes, Calone, Blueberry, Neroli, and Peach are found in the heart. It is crafted out of Ambroxan, Musk, and Cedar on the base, providing it with a clean and smooth finish.

products.title: Le Labo Cedrat 37 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Cedrat 37 Eau de Parfum is a clean and fresh unisex fragrance that is bright immediately after spraying. It begins with crisp citron, which smells natural, juicy, and bitter to some extent. Warm ginger is then added, providing a mild spicy feel. Musk, woody and ambergris at the bottom form a long-lasting and smooth finish. It is easy and elegant, contemporary and comfortable to wear.

products.title: Rasasi Qasamat Bareeq Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Qasamat Bareeq Eau De Parfum is a modern and lavish unisex fragrance that characterizes the house of Rasasi. It has clean and bright citrusy and fruity notes that come through fresh and a bit green. The scent, as it matures, gives off warmth, softness, spices, sweetness and a little floral fragrance. The base is strong and gentle with some leather, musk, woods and earth notes that last on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Nasomatto Black Afgano Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nasomatto Black Afgano Extrait de Parfum is a bold, dark and deep unisex perfume from the house of Nasomatto. This fragrance is known for its intense woody and smoky feel with a rich and mysterious character. It opens with strong green and herbal notes mixed with a dark earthy touch, slowly moving into warm resins, coffee and tobacco. The base is heavy, long lasting and very strong with a powerful mix of oud, incense, amber and musky notes that stay on the skin for hours.

products.title: Killian Rolling in Love Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rolling in Love by By Kilian is a women's and men's Oriental Floral fragrance. Rolling in Love was released in 2019. The nose of this perfume is Pascal Gaurin. The top notes are Almond Milk and Ambrette (Musk Mallow); middle notes are Iris, Freesia, Heliotrope, Raspberry, Hedione, and Peony; and the bottom note is Vanilla, Tuberose, Tonka Bean, Musk, Lactones and Caramel.

products.title: French Avenue Meringue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Meringue Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy and modern women’s perfume for those who love sweet but balanced scents. It opens fresh and juicy with pineapple, mandarin and bergamot that feel bright and happy. Slowly, it turns smooth and cozy with suede and sandalwood at its middle notes. The base is warm and comforting with vanilla, white musk, birch and ambergris, giving it a clean yet slightly woody finish.

products.title: Al Haramain White Oudh Attar Roll On
products.body_html: White Oudh by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Artemisia, Lemon, Orange and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Freesia, Patchouli and Black Currant; base notes are Tobacco, Amber and Musk.

products.title: Al Haramain Makkah Attar Roll On
products.body_html: Makkah by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Citruses and Green Notes; middle notes are Big Strawberry, Orange Blossom and Jasmine; base notes are Resins, Amber, Powdery Notes, Vanilla and Musk.

products.title: Al Haramain Black Oud Attar Roll On
products.body_html: Black Oudh by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Top note is Musk; middle notes are Cedar and Herbal Notes; base notes are Amber, Patchouli and Vanilla.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Attar Roll On
products.body_html: Amber by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Spicy Notes, Saffron, Geranium, Cloves, Lemon and Lavender; middle notes are Sandalwood, Rose, Cedar, Orris and Artemisia; base notes are Amber, Patchouli, Labdanum, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, Musk and Amyris.

products.title: Roja Apex Eau Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Roja Apex Eau Intense Eau de Parfum is a fresh, green and strong perfume that is intended to be worn by both men and women. Produced by Roja Parfums, this 2025 collection is self-confident and contemporary. It starts to be very bright and herbal and gradually becomes woody and smooth. The combination of mint, citrus, grass and woods is rather strong in the sense of nature, even though it sounds classy and rich.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Man Hair Mist
products.body_html: Club de Nuit Intense Man by Armaf is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Club de Nuit Intense Man was launched in 2015. Top notes are Lemon, Pineapple, Bergamot, Black Currant and Apple; middle notes are Birch, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Musk, Ambergris, Patchouli and Vanilla.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent L’Homme Eau de Toilette is a light and fresh male perfume that is spicy and mild. It is sublime and clean yet also homely and masculine. The introduction begins with oranges and ginger that provide a refreshing effect. Then, soft spices and violet leaf arrive after a long while, which gives a smooth aspect. During the dry down, tonka bean, cedar and vetiver form a warm woody base, which remains softly pinned on the skin.

products.title: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum is a rich and sweet fragrance made for women who love warm and creamy scents. The opening feels nutty and smooth with black currant, hazelnut, milk and praline, giving a soft gourmand touch. In the heart, rose, jasmine, and iris add a floral beauty, while cacao brings a slight chocolate feel. The base is deep and warm with vanilla, honey, musk and sandalwood that stays on skin for long hours. It feels elegant, cozy and a little addictive.

products.title: Lattafa Esraa Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Attar Esraa by Lattafa Perfumes is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Attar Esraa was launched in 2025. Top notes are Blackcurrant, Lychee and Apple; middle notes are Rose, Red Fruits and Raspberry; base notes are Musk, Caramel and Vanilla.

products.title: Bath & Body Works If you Musk Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: If You Musk by Bath & Body Works is a Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. If You Musk was launched in 2024.

products.title: Diptyque  Fleur De Peau Hand & Body Gel
products.body_html: A tribute to the sensual, stimulating qualities of musk. On contact with water, this gel becomes an unbelievably silky cleansing foam. Enriched with shea butter, it perfumes the body intensively while leaving it softened and invigorated. Musk, with nuances of iris and ambrette seed, enhances the skin with a timeless fragrance.

products.title: Riiffs Surge & Spectra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs R Spectra Eau dePerfum is an assertive and hot fragrance that is both hot and somewhat sweet to the touch of the man. It has a combination of orange blossom and white pepper as the beginning, which makes it fresh and sharp. As it subsides, you have warm violet, nutmeg and sweetness. Amber, vanilla bean and patchouli provide a rich, smooth and extended low in the dry down. It is contemporary, masculine, and suitable for those men who use oriental spicy perfumes that are very rich.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum is a women's perfume that is warm and elegant, and it is sweet, flowery, and slightly spicy. It opens bright with bergamot, orange and blackcurrant combined with sweet notes and saffron to give it a good first impression. It is smooth and feminine, and as if out of nothing, slow and soft jasmine and violet emerge. The foundation of musk, amber, cashmeran, and moss remains long-lasting on the skin and is comfortable, deep, and luxurious for hours.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Onyx Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Onyx Extrait de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and warm perfume that is designed to be used by men and women alike. It begins with gentle vanilla orchid and ylang ylang that is blended in with the touch of whipped cream that is rich and comforting. The heart is serving rose and peony with a small twist of fruity blackcurrant. Caramel, woods and incense render it deep in the dry down, sweet and to a certain extent smoky. It is classy, welcoming and highly enjoyable.
